title: Redesign album and artist list pages
description:
Overhaul the desktop AlbumsPage and ArtistsPage to be more visually interesting, responsive, and content-rich.

**Current issues:**
- Pages are not responsive enough
- Performance/lag issues (image loading)
- Boring/plain design with no visual hierarchy

**Planned improvements:**

1. **Enhanced cards:**
   - Improved AlbumCard with hover-lift, better shadows, subtle scale
   - New ArtistCard component with circular avatars
   
2. **More content/sections:**
   - Stats header ("247 albums • 89 artists • 2,451 songs")
   - Recently added row/carousel at top
   - Alphabet quick-nav for jumping to sections
   
3. **Better grid/responsiveness:**
   - Fluid responsive grid using minmax() instead of fixed breakpoints
   - Keep virtual scrolling for performance
   
4. **Visual polish:**
   - Staggered fade-in animations for cards
   - Better hover states with scale + shadow transitions

title: Fullscreen player controls + expressive button styling
description: Restore main fullscreen player controls (play/pause, next/prev, scrubber, metadata) and restyle control groups to match Material 3 expressive reference.

title: Material 3 expressive shape audit
description: Audit recent UI changes against Material 3 Expressive with focus on shape language and player/fullscreen components. Provide checklist and apply targeted fixes.

title: Plan native mobile architecture
description: Extract Rust core crate, remove mobile web UI, begin native Android app scaffolding

title: Home featured diagonal pill badge
description: Add expressive diagonal pill accent in desktop home featured section.

title: Fix favorite button styling in player view
description: The favorite button in the player view uses the wrong button type. When a song is favorited, the background changes to use the accent color. Instead, it should work like the favorite button in the fullscreen player, where it just changes between hollow/filled depending on if the song is favorited.
